method.chapter: Already shell-free; both chapter CSVs are byte-identical across flags, a second negative control.
method.clusterIntervals: 1000 resamples of100 whole-profile mean paired differences, each from30 repetitions; within-model cohort sensitivity, not human population confidence.
method.earlyLevels: Exact row-hash equality for all U1-U10 attempt records is a negative control before shell introduction.
method.horizon: Original outcome labels retained; separate sensitivity includes horizon_censored rows already at zero budget with pieces remaining.
method.intervention: Only shell initialization switches to empty. Existing Board/budget/energy/economy/help/agent and timing/utility formulas unchanged. Fork metadata is explicit and not shipped.
method.knowledgeMetric: Not compared: an absent shell rule is not trained; averaging that unused rule with four shared rules would misstate common-rule learning.
method.limits: Structured visible state, no rendering, sprite recognition, emotion, human understanding, enjoyment or retention measurement.
method.manual: Tap-executed exits include following explicit assistance. Complete CSV records cue observations but not exact full-cohort guided manual exits; do not infer unaided mastery.
method.paired: Same profiles.json bytes, profile/repetition/scenario IDs, geometry catalogue and keyed random seeds. Later state/action paths and campaign exposure diverge.
method.rateDenominators: Pooled counters use exact total numerators/denominators. Paired rates use each trajectory denominator and mean paired difference.
method.transfer: No-shell applies to training and held-out probes. Probe completion cannot isolate acquired learning because the tested shell environment also changes.

transfer.design: Only final learned rule states transplanted; reset fatigue/frustration/memory, equal180 coins; all coach, dead-end, Focus, companion and causal cues disabled. Different campaign exposure is retained, so this is training-regime transfer, not a pure cue-learning causal effect.
